d'Alba Double Pad is perfect before makeup. It gently smooths and hydrates my skin, leaving it fresh and glowing so my makeup applies more smoothly and evenly.

avis.titre: Great Design and Left My Skin Feeling Amazing
avis.texte: I received the d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pad for free from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I initially had a little trouble figuring out how to use it since I couldn't find English instructions on the container. Once I figured it out, though, I really enjoyed the product. The packaging is thoughtfully designed, with two separate compartments and tweezers conveniently stored inside the lid. The smaller green pads are used for exfoliating, while the larger yellow pads can be left on the skin for 5–10 minutes like a mini sheet mask. My skin felt noticeably soft, refreshed, and hydrated immediately afterward. Despite the initial confusion, the experience and results were excellent. 5/5!
I really enjoyed using these mask pads! They're super convenient, easy to use, and packed with serum. They leave my skin feeling hydrated, smooth, and refreshed without feeling heavy or sticky.

I struggled to get this open the pads were all super wet, which is great. I just don't have time once in a while. It's a good thing, but it's not something I would use every day. I just don't have the time but they're great. They hydrate wherever you put them it sinks in it works. I just took off a star. Because it's time consuming.
These are soooo perfect for the morning, especially while I'm getting ready i can leave the quick mask on for deep hydration before my makeup
This combination packed a serious punch when it came to moisture! Moisture, moisture everywhere! My face has never felt so hydrated, and the glow lasted for hours.

avis.titre: A great addition to my anti-aging skincare routine!
avis.texte: I'm really loving these mask pads! They're super easy to use and leave my skin feeling hydrated, refreshed, and noticeably smoother. I especially love that there are different pads for targeted care, so I can focus on the areas that need a little extra attention. My skin looks plumper and has such a nice healthy glow afterward. A great addition to my anti-aging skincare routine!

I used the masks before my makeup and it makes my skin smooth and gently exfoliate to make sure there's no dry patch and make my skin very smooth and hydrated afterwards. It has light citric scents that's i enjoy. Highly recommend!

I love how effective the d'Alba Liposome Serum Mask Pad is. It instantly refreshes, hydrates, and leaves my skin looking calm and dewy. The serum absorbs beautifully and gives a healthy, balanced glow.
This has really improved the texture and feeling of my skin. Easy to use and beauty packaging.

I absolutely love the d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pad! The serum-soaked pads are incredibly convenient and perfect for days when I don't have time for a full sheet mask. They feel refreshing and leave my skin looking hydrated, plump, and noticeably more radiant after just a few minutes. The serum absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or heavy, making it easy to continue with the rest of my skincare routine. The liposome technology helps deliver the active ingredients more effectively, while the nourishing formula supports the skin barrier and provides long-lasting moisture. After using these pads for a while, my skin looks healthier, smoother, and much more glowy.
Initially I didn't think these would do much, but my face has never felt so moisturized. I've gotten compliments on how glowy I look
I have some areas of my face that are a bit uneven and this really seemed to brighten and even things out after just a few uses. The redness has lessened as well

avis.titre: Made my skin feel soft and smooth
avis.texte: These pads really renewed my skin and left it feeling soft and smooth. I have dry, mature skin with light texture. I used this product twice a day for 2 weeks and it really softened the texture and left my skin feeling hydrated and smooth. The packaging was convenient and durable and each pad was saturated with product. I loved the little plastic tongs provided to help grip the pads. The serums didn't have an overwhelming fragrance and didn't leave my skin sticky or tacky. Overall I'm very happy with this product and just purchased a replacement. Thank you for the sampling opportunity.

I was sent this in exchange for my review. Amazing packaging d'alba always thinks everything through! From the little mask tweezer having a poker end to pull up masks to having a place to store them in the lid. So impressive. Masks work great! are lightly scented but love that this tackles so many different things in one container!
i really like the texture of this product - it has good slip and feels like it absorbs really well. i can't speak to long term use though.

I received this a gift in exchange for my honest opinion. I love how soaked in serum these pads are. I am planning on using the extra serum on extra pads I will diy to use all of the liquid! Right now, I'm using them on my face and the extra juice I use it on neck and décolleté, as well as on hands. They make my skin feel so refreshed. The only thing I'm not a big fan of is the dewy finish, but I just use a dry sunscreen which works wonderfully with this!! I definitely love using these pads, especially on dry days or whenever my skin is feeling sensitive. The amount is pretty generous, 90 pads! I will definitely replenish these.

This is a fun product to use because of the thoughtful packaging. The little tweezers and the case are a nice touch. After using both pads, your skin is seriously glowing. My husband even commented on it. It does have a fragrance so those who want a fragrance free product may not enjoy it.

I received this product free in exchange for my honest review. Firstly, I really enjoy the packaging of this product and found it a cute little all-in-one box, even with a holder for the tongs inside the lid - most of the time when products include an applicator like that, the storage for that is an afterthought. The serum pads are nice and perform well for their intended purpose (green exfoliating and yellow hydrating). It's convenient to have both steps in the same package too. For me, cons are that it doesn't seem to be a refillable system, and the number of pads are uneven - instructions say to use the green pad and follow up with yellow, so why are there only 30 green and then 70 yellow? You will use them up at a different pace. It also says you can use day or night and that this is a good prep for makeup application, but while this is very gentle I prefer not to do any exfoliation during the day as my skin becomes more vulnerable to the sun. Overall, I do enjoy this product and would recommend it if you are looking for something like this. I hope they make refills in the future.

I love the packaging on these! The pads stay fresh and don't dry out. I also love that you can use the two pads together or choose one depending on what your skin needs that day. The yellow pads are especially moisturizing and leave my skin with a beautiful glow. They also felt gentle on my skin and didn't cause any irritation.

I loved the packaging on this product, and thank you d'Alba for including tweezers! The pads are great to use individually by grabbing and placing on the face like a mask or by gliding over the skin. My skin was left so hydrated and when I used the green pad my skin also felt soft after as the pad had a different texture that provided some gentle exfoliation. Loved my experience and would recommend! I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I really like this cream! It feels really nice on my skin and leaves it feeling soft and moisturized without being greasy. I've been using it around my eyes and smile lines, and my skin definitely looks a little more plump and smooth afterward. I also like the little applicator that comes with it. You don't need much, so I think the jar will last a good while. I'm really happy with it and will probably buy it again.

I absolutely loved the d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pad! My skin felt incredibly soft, hydrated, and refreshed after using it. The serum absorbed beautifully without leaving my skin feeling heavy or sticky, and my face looked noticeably more radiant afterward. It's such an easy addition to my skincare routine when my skin needs a little extra boost. I'll definitely be using these again

I love a good skin prep before I apply my makeup for the day or just want a natural glow and I was so excited for this product. I love how elevated the look of the box is and how the product feels on my skin. It takes no time at all and it makes my skin look flawless with makeup! It creates a beautiful glow! I did find myself, however, only using the exfoliating pads because I felt that the hydrating masks were an unnecessary step in the process, just an added luxury. Still, yet again, Korean skincare is top tier for me.

These mask pads feel refreshing and hydrating on my skin. They're easy to use and leave my skin feeling soft, smooth, and moisturized. I especially like using them as part of my nighttime skincare routine.
This product was nice, but a little too fragranced for me. I like that it had two sides so i could pick what i wanted to tone my skin with depending on the day.

The d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pads have become one of my favorite skincare steps when my skin needs a quick refresh. I have sensitive dry combination skin. The pads are generously soaked with serum and feel soft and comfortable on my skin. They instantly leave my face feeling hydrated, calm, and refreshed without any sticky residue. I like using them as a quick mask for a few minutes before moisturizing, and my skin always looks smoother and more radiant. The formula feels gentle, making it suitable even when my skin is feeling a little dry or sensitive. Overall, these serum mask pads are a convenient way to add an extra boost of hydration and give my complexion a healthy, dewy glow.

I've been really impressed with these Pads. The dual-pad concept is actually very practical, one side gently exfoliates while the other delivers a generous amount of hydrating serum. My skin feels smoother, deeply hydrated, and has a healthy glow after each use. If you're looking for an easy way to add hydration and radiance to your skincare routine, these are definitely worth trying. I would absolutely repurchase them.

What an amazing product! I will start with the packaging which is by far one of my favorites, very easy to use, and doesn't spill. The pads are soaked with the serum and they are not dry. The green pads are thicker since they are dual sided with one exfoliating and the other one cleaning up pores and getting rid of dead skin cells. They have a slight scent which to my nose is very clean and spa like. The yellow pads are simply the best. They are dipped in serum and hydrate and leave your skin smoothed out. Another reason I think these pads are wonderful is that they seem great for sensitive skin which I have. It also makes makeup application a dream by not making it cakey. I believe this will be a product you will reach for daily in your skincare routine. A must have serum mask.

I love how the packaging is setup for this skincare prep! One side you get gentle exfoliating pads to help clear your face from flaky skin, bumps and any congestion. Then the other side has skin prep pads to moisturize your face and feel smooth and soft with deep hydration. It's perfect for skin prep before I apply my makeup. I've seen a noticeable glow and supple looking skin after using this skin prep. I love it.

This summer has really dried out my skin and I have noticed an increase in the texture, which causes my makeup to look patchy. This his serum mask pad has helped add that extra hydration to my makeup routine, helping my foundation go on smoothly and offer relief to my dry skin

I love these!!! I never thought makeup prep would be this awesome!!!! There's a little scent to it but not overpowering, it makes my skin moisturized and hydrated! Never experience irritation and my skin just loves it!

After using them, my skin looks healthier, feels soft, and my makeup applies much more evenly. My 42 year old skin had fallen in love with these pads! They helped improve my texture and I adore the fresh citrus scent!! They haven't caused any reaction but I don't have sensitive skin. I use the collagen pad more frequently than the peeling pad but the peeling pad is super gentle! I've truly enjoyed using these and highly recommend them!
My favortie skin prep. My doubdation goes on so smoothly after. I like the 2 step system. Leaves my skin feeling so glowy.

I love how this makes my skincare routine so much easier! The two types of pads make it simple to exfoliate and add hydration without needing multiple products. These serum mask pads are so refreshing and hydrating! They leave my skin feeling soft, smooth, and looking more radiant in just a few minutes. They're easy to use and perfect for a quick skincare boost.

I absolutely loved these! My skin felt so smooth, hydrated, and refreshed after using them, and I noticed my makeup applied more evenly. I also loved the healthy looking glow they left behind. Such an easy step to add before makeup, and I'll definitely be repurchasing!
I love how refresh and clean my skin feels. I use this for just skincare or before I apply my makeup.

avis.titre: This really change how my make up look

I used the green pads as a toner/serum and the yellow as a mask (on different days) and both left my skin so dewy and hydrated, even as someone with dry, maturing skin! I took a weekend trip to the desert and missed these in my routine. Overall I would buy this product but it would be helpful to have some instructions on how to use the two serum pads.

If you're dealing with postpartum skin that's looking tired, textured, or congested, these pads have been such a game changer for me. I love that you get two types of pads in one container—one focuses on gentle exfoliation while the other delivers a boost of hydration. Using them a few times a week helped smooth my skin, reduce the look of the little postpartum bumps I was getting, and left my face looking brighter without irritation. My skin always feels incredibly soft and refreshed afterward, and they prep my skin so well for the rest of my routine. They've become one of those products I reach for whenever my skin needs a quick reset. These are honest skincare experiences, and while no product can guarantee clearing acne, keeping your skin hydrated and gently exfoliated can absolutely help improve the overall look and feel of postpartum skin.

I love the two in one set up and these are truly so luxurious to use. Exfoliating without stripping the skin of any moisture and then also helping rejuvinate a glowing and healthy complexion. I would definitely repurchase and recommend these to others.
It was amazing!!! It made my face so glowy and moisturized. I added this into my daily routine.

I received this product as promotion, but really ended up loving it. I plan on purchasing. My skin looked great after, but only after I looked up the instructions- which is why I'm giving it 4 stars. avis.titre: Absolutely obsessed with these serum pads
avis.texte: These have quickly become one of my favorite skincare products. I love that I can choose exactly what my skin needs that day. The yellow collagen/vitamin side leaves my skin feeling incredibly nourished, plump, and gives me the prettiest healthy glow. The pads are generously soaked without being messy, and my skin always feels soft and smooth afterward. This product is so amazing and comfort to my skin. I wipe it with green pad then apply the yellow on both of my cheek and forehead for 5 minutes. I love the smell of the yellow pads so much. I just take a quick 5 minutes nap with them on then getting the glowing.

This product cleanses and rapidly hydrates the skin (skin prep) before makeup application, ensuring a smooth, non-cakey base while maintaining a natural, dewy glow. It is effective at gently exfoliating, clearing out sebaceous filaments, refining pores, and soothing the skin.

I first tried the hydrating pads (yellow) and had the most incredible glow on my skin. It was not sticky nor did it affect makeup application. It was amazing! I liked the green ones as well but didn't find them to be as quite as beneficial for my skin type.
This is a nice "mask", left my skin glowing and moisturized!! My favis the collagen one.

The green side is refreshing for cleansing away all day dirt and oils, and the yellow sheets are amazingly refreshing vitamin c and hydration. This works wonders under my matte powder foundation. Love this stuff for my skin prep.

Maybe it's just the one I received, but the box itself was covered in an oily substance, the plastic insert was near impossible to remove so I'm not sure it comes out. It comes with tweezers to pick up the pads but the don't come out of the plastic slots easily and get stuff and tear coming out. Outside of that, they do have a scent, not overpowering just be aware if you are sensitive. That didn't bother me. I do like the cooking pads especially in this hot Texas heat they feel nice. Not sure I'd recommend just based on packaging.

The product itself is fine. I don't think I notice a huge difference between the yellow and green sides. My skin feels great after either one. I will say, I like a face mask, but I do wear glasses. Having this mask in pieces, makes it much easier to wear my glasses and get the benefit of a face mask.

This is a fun set, I like how there are two different steps. I didn't love the results however. My skin still felt pretty dry and I experienced some breakouts so I don't think it's a great fit for me personally. It also was a little involved to have to leave it on for a few minutes each night and I had trouble just getting one pad at a time to come out (the tweezers didn't really help) so I wouldn't buy these again.

This was essentially a 2-step prep system designed to help your makeup go on smoother and help prevent a "cakey" finish. This worked well for my aging skin. Although I no longer use a lot of face makeup, this duo leaves my skin smooth and slightly dewey. I would say this help exfoliate and hydrate my skin, but I didn't necessarily see an improvement in its elasticity (but that could be due to my age).

I have always liked d'alba line of products and was so happy that I got to try this product. When I first opened it, its looks so luxurious. The scent is ok. However I really like the way it feels when I am using it to wipe my face.

I've tried a lot of sheet masks, but these are so much easier to use. The serum is lightweight, super hydrating, and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky afterward. I love that I can use a few pads on the areas that need extra moisture instead of committing to a full face mask. My skin looked fresher and felt noticeably softer after using them. They're perfect for a quick self-care moment before makeup or before bed.

I had never used this brand before but was intrigued by the description. This teonsteo process is quick, but feels luxurious. The green pad is a toner like product, and leaves my skin with a cooling sensation. The green pads are thicker than the yellow. The yellow pads are the second step, leaving my skin plump like. My skin care and make up seem to go on smoother and just look better all day. I have combination skin, with an oily t zone and have personally had any issues using this product.

⋆˚࿔⊹ The green peeling pad uses PHA (gluconolactone) and LHA (capryloyl salicylic acid), the gentle exfoliating acids. PHA has a large molecule that works slowly on the surface without stinging, and LHA clears inside the pore at a gentler pace than standard BHA. ⋆˚࿔⊹ The embossed texture is mechanical + chemical, the physical bumps lift dead cells while the acids dissolve them, so you refine texture two ways in one swipe. ⋆˚࿔⊹ The yellow collagen gel pad is the recovery half, hydrolyzed collagen plus a long stack of hyaluronic acids in different sizes replenish what exfoliation can leave feeling bare. The liposome delivery system is the reason it absorbs, actives wrapped in lipid spheres slip through the skin's surface instead of sitting on top. ⋆˚࿔⊹ Retinal (not retinol) sits in both pads, the faster-acting form of vitamin A, at a low supporting level, adding a gentle renewal note alongside the acids. Centella, tea tree water and Coptis root keep it calm, soothing and antibacterial support so exfoliation doesn't tip into irritation. ⋆˚࿔⊹ Best for dull, rough, uneven texture, congestion, and makeup prep.

Serum‑infused pads provide both hydration and treatment benefits without needing multiple steps. Convenient mask‑like effect when left on the skin for a few minutes. They glide easily across the skin, leaving a lightweight, non‑sticky finish. When used as a mini mask, they adhere well and give a spa‑like boost. Instant hydration and plumpness. Helps calm mild irritation or dryness and Works well before makeup for a smooth base.

I was gifted d'Alba Piedmont's Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pads to try in exchange for my honest review. After using them for several weeks, I really like the product a lot! It's great to have an exfoliating/toning product and a serum/mask product combined in a single package, it makes it very easy to go from one step of my skincare routine to the next. The packaging is also very nice and upscale — it comes with tweezers that you can use to pick up each pad, so you never have to touch them in the package and there's no risk of contamination. Both products feel great on my skin! I was worried that the exfoliating pads might be a bit harsh or sting, but they're actually incredibly soothing! The serum masks have a very nice texture, it's almost slimy/slippery, but in a good way! After wiping my face thoroughly with the exfoliating/toning pad, I place one of the serum pads on each cheek, one on my forehead, and sometimes one on my chin as well. My skin sucks the moisture right up after 10 minutes or so, and feels nice and soft afterwards. They stay in place very well until I take them off. The only thing I would change is making the serum masks full masks, it's a shame that my entire face doesn't get the benefit of the masks! Although the packaging is very high-end, this product is actually quite affordable, too! I highly recommend it!

These exfoliating and moisturizing pads are very fun to use and gentle on the skin. I like to apply the yellow one which is the collagen one as a spot mask for 5 to 10 minutes on areas of my face that need a little more moisture. The green ones are great for gentle exfoliation and I like to use them in a swiping motion on my forehead and cheeks. I have found that over two weeks of use, my skin looks more hydrated, and some of my small texture is improving. I think this is pretty good product and it's nice to use. I also appreciate the tweezer to separate and pick up individual pads because it's much better than using the fingers and causing a mess of the product.
This got me in the chokhold because of the glow and radiance it gave my skin. I am speechless and this is my ultimate holygrail.

I really like this. The fragrance is very nice it feels good on my face. It goes on nice and smooth and leaves my face so nice. My face started looking better after the 2nd time i used it. My face is nice and smooth and hydrated.

I've tried a lot of skincare products, so I wasn't expecting these to stand out, but the d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pads ended up being a pleasant surprise. What I like most is how easy they are to use. Some days I just swipe the toner pad over my face, and other days I'll leave the gel pads on for a few minutes while I'm getting ready. It's a nice option when I don't have time for a full sheet mask. After using them, my skin feels really hydrated and looks a little brighter and more refreshed. I also noticed my makeup goes on a bit smoother afterward, which is always a bonus. The only thing that might not be for everyone is the fragrance. It didn't bother me, but if you're really sensitive to scented skincare, it's something to keep in mind. Overall, I think these are worth trying if you're looking for a quick way to add hydration to your routine. They're not one of those products that instantly transforms your skin, but they leave my face feeling soft, moisturized, and looking healthier. I'll definitely keep reaching for them.

I've been adding this 5-minute prep with the d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pad before makeup, and my base has never looked smoother or glowier.

I like that it's two products in one package. I typically only use the collagen pads once per week and the exfoliating toner pads a few times per week.

Thank you for the free sample to try out. This is a great product. First, it is beautifully packaged. It comes in a divided container. One side holds the exfoliating pads and one has the moisturizing pads. There is also an included pair of tweezers to get the pads out and there is a spot on the lid that holds the tweezers. To use, you first use the green exfoliating pads. Afterwards, you use the yellow monitoring pads. You can leave them on while you do your hair or brush your teeth. Your skin will feel smooth and moisturized.

I was super excited to try this product. I love a good mask. It has both pros and cons i will start with the cons. Cons. The box is all in chinese. It makes it hard to read the instructions to know what order to do the mask. The only English words is the name of the product and the ingredients. Pros Love the cute little box that it comes in. Makes it easy to use and dont have to worry about it leaking. It even comes with a little pair of tweezers so that you can pull the mask out. It feels refreshing and light weight on my skin and after my face feels refreshing and so smooth. There is plenty of product and a nice size to the masks.

I am absolutely floored by using the d'Alba serum mask pads. The added collagen toning in each pad has made my skin and face feel so smooth and full of that makes sense? The toner keeps my face clean and my skin barrier feels strong. I really like this product!

I received this product as a free sample in exchange for my honest review. I was pleasantly surprised by the package and both pads. I like that they are separate. Both pads offer so much hydration and so far my skin has been loving them both. I will continue to use them both but only at night to let me skin enough time to absorb the serum properly.

These serum mask pads are incredibly convenient. My face both feels and looks noticeably more hydrated immediately after using. The pads are generously saturated without being messy and the serum absorbs well without leaving a sticky finish on my skin. Great for a quick moisture boost, morning or night!

I do want to share that I did receive these for free to try in exchange for giving my thoughts after using for a while. The first thing that pleasantly surprised me was the amount of product you get in the package. There are 2 different types and one first soothes and tones and it is a very refreshing feeling. Then there are the ones that you leave on each side of your face for about 10 minutes is what I have been doing and you automatically see a bit of a glowing effect after. They also noticeably helped me with a particularly puffy under eye issue one morning (I think I left them on 15 minutes that day). I actually do look forward to continuing to use these and have noticed that it seems to sooth and improve my tone enough that I chose to barely use foundation a couple of days ago. I hope you give it a try to see how you like it. It's the soothing aspect and glow that has me impressed. I felt like I had to learn how to use it more from videos I searched than anything in the packaging but there's plenty of videos out there and it actually was fun to learn how others applied and used them.
I love the d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pads! They leave my skin silky smooth with a radiant, flowing complexion. I highly recommend these serum pads for a supple glow!

avis.titre: My secret to a smooth, hydrated makeup base
avis.texte: I absolutely love these pads for my makeup prep routine! The two-step system is so easy to use—the green pad gently smooths my skin, and the yellow pad gives my skin the hydration it needs. After using them, my skin feels soft, fresh, and beautifully hydrated, and my makeup applies so much better. They've quickly become one of my favorite steps before makeup when I want that smooth, glowy, makeup-ready finish! ✨

I have been trying these pads for a few weeks now. And seriously it makes a huge difference when i use it. My makeup last long. The dewy finish also stays all day. Doesn't break out my foundation. Or my skin. Brings back the healthy glow and hydration.

This pad set is super easy to use and feels great. They're less a tradition mask and more a multi-step routine. The pads made application super easy and the packaging is lovely. It worked really well in tandem with the grinding cream for a layered routine. After a little over two weeks my skin feels more moisturized and plump. My only complaint is the inserts that come inside each section for use with the little tweezers are hard to use, so I ended up removing them. Love that they're vegan, wish they were cruelty-free/not tested on animals as well.

avis.titre: 2 in 1 toner system for fresh hydration
avis.texte: I love how you can solve for 2 skin issues in one. The exfoliating pad provides gentle exfoliation for the skin and the hydrating pad I can leave one for a while to soak in the rich moisturizer. This leave my skin feeling soothed and plump. I've never used d'Alba products before but I'm a huge fan now!

I absolutely love the d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pad! After just one use, my skin felt incredibly hydrated, smooth, and radiant. It gave my complexion a healthy glow and left my face feeling refreshed and amazingly soft. This has quickly become one of my favorite skincare products, and I'll definitely be keeping it in my routine!

I received this for free in exchange for my honest review. This is a gem of a product. It comes with two different sets of facial pads- one side for exfoliation (green) and one side for collagen/hydration (yellow side). These pads feel and smell amazing. If you are looking for a med spa experience at home that leaves your skin feeling cool, hydrated and glowy- look no further. 10/10 at home spa experience. The yellow collagen pads even stick to your skin if you want to leave them on longer as a face mask. Love these pads and highly recommend them!

I received this product for free to review. I really loved this product it comes with a little pair of tweezers to get the pads out of there without having to touch all of them so it keeps it sanitary. My skin feels amazing after using this, it's so soft and smooth, I follow it up with the d'Alba Intensive Volufiline Grinding Cream and my skin is super happy right now! I will say that packaging does not come with English instructions but after translating it was easy to know what to do.
This cream is amazing. It has a nice light scent, gives good hydration, makes your skin plump and is not too oily. The grinding mechanism makes the product feel luxurious and keeps the product fresh.

The d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pad is a great kit! The pads are super saturated and smell great! They were a little lacking in the instruction department, so I did what seemed to be the logical thing, exfoliator pad then mask pad. They really felt luxurious and made my skin really soft.

I've never used pre moistened sheets like these but I found that I really like them. They may feel a little "slimy" at first but I absolutely love the way my skin feels after using them. The only thing I find odd is that it comes with double the moisturizing sheets than exfoliating sheets and only use one per night. It's also nice that these are sheets as I can use them on my face and then use any extra on my hands if they're dry.

I wanted to love this product, but as a 45 year old with a solid skincare routine, I couldn't find a place where this fit in. I think it's great for someone looking to add solid skincare to their morning routine. However, I don't think it outshines any of the products I'm already using.

I really like this two step system. You get a side of a calming toner and a side of a collagen gel pad. Really cool how they made this. My skin really feels nice and smooth. I wouldn't expose myself to the sun while using this. Texture did improve and it has a nice fresh fragrance.

This serum mask left my skin looking fresh, hydrated, and glowing after just one use. Love that it feels calming and moisturizing while still giving that healthy glass skin look d'Alba is known for. Easy to use and your skins feels amazing after not sticky just smooth! You definitely need to buy them; you won't be disappointed.
On the go? This 2-in-1 is perfect for quick and easy on the go exfoliating and the mask gives you tje perfect glow to head out the door!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: If you love toner pads and mask this 2 in 1 duo is the best! I have added these to my everyday skincare routine and I can say my skin feels so much more hydrating and looks healthier with a beautiful glow!

Thanks to d'Alba for inviting me to try their Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pad for an honest review. And honestly it is great- both parts! First, the exfoliating pad with serum gently exfoliates and the the soft pad moisturizes beautifully. My skin was instantly transformed and my makeup looked much better after using this in my AM routine. My skin was much improved after the first use and I have continued to love this product using it daily.

I had zero idea what to expect but I do know that my lips get very fro and chapped in the summer. I did this once a week for a couple of weeks and saw such a drastic improvement. I don't get to use K beauty too often but will definitely buy this again.

avis.titre: Made my senses feel like I went to the spa..
avis.texte: d' Alba piedmont kindly gave me this double mask pad for free so that I could review it. When I went to use it the first thing I noticed was there were no directions in English anywhere. Not on outer box nor inside. So had to look up how I should use these pads. That's being said, after having used them repeatedly I am in love! The refreshing smell that hits you as soon as you pop open the seal it amazing… the embossed pads really felt good removing some areas of dry dead skin… and since my skin is on the drier side it was refreshing to put the hydrating pads on afterwards.. it nice to make it a routine and lay down for 10/20 minutes with them on your face to get the full effect. Small hint I place mine in the fridge so they are even more refreshing! I follow with the intensive cream afterwards and my skin thanks me and d' Alba! I will be purchasing this as soon as I run out!

This product is amazing. It provides instant hydration and leaves my skin glowy. I use it to prep my skin before makeup and the result is perfect. A great choice if you're looking for a quick and easy hydration boos.

This double pad and mask set is great! I love that it offers me 2 in one. The tweezers that come with us are so useful, also with a holding spot in the inside of the lid. I love the moisture the little masks give my face!

Two products in one, this set contains an exfoliating (green) pad and a 5 minute face mask (yellow). Being a K-Beauty product, the instructions are in Korean, which made figuring out how to use the product a little confusing. Using the images on the box as clues and some googling, I started using the product as follows: after cleansing I would use the green pad and wipe my face down with the exfoliating solution. After that dried I would use 3 of the face mask pads; one on my forehead and one on each cheek (near my frown lines). After about 5-10 mins I would remove the pads and gently pat any remaining product into my skin. I thought the results were great! My skin was left super plump and juicy, soft and with a hydrated glow. My make up went on smoother and overall I feel like my complex just looks brighter.

avis.titre: Glow game changer, so worth it
avis.texte: Thank you so much for sending me this product to try in exchange for an honest review. I will admit that I was skeptical at first but my mind changed after the first use. I have red cheeks and applied the calming pads to those areas. It didn't do much to calm the redness. I applied the collagen gel pads on my cheeks and forehead, leaving them to penetrate for about 10 minutes. They left my skin looking so radiant and my skin had a glow! I personally prefer the calming pads. I really appreciate that tweezers are included to help separate and grab the right amount of product. It also helps keep the contents of the product hygienic.

avis.titre: I would buy this again, skin is glowing
avis.texte: I love the results you get with these pads. The packaging needs work, I got frustrated using the tweezers to remove the pads through the slats so I removed the plastic and grabbed them that way. Love the overall result. I received this product for free in return for my honest review!

The d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pad is a luxurious duo that both tones and hydrates the skin. I received a free sample for the purpose of an honest review. This wonderfully packaged product is best used in the morning, because it preps the skin for makeup application. I have dry skin, and sometimes toners really dry my skin out even more. This one did not do so! It is a simple system that is packaged so well. You take the toner pad and go over your skin; you may also leave the pads on for a few minutes, if you choose to. . Then you move on to the Vita Toning Collagen Gel Pad. Simply place the pads onto the face on areas that need hydration. Leave them on a few minutes, remove, and massage the serum into your skin. The ingredients are excellent . Skin is refreshed, toned, with superior hydration. Your skin will have a beautiful glassy appearance, and it is prepped for your foundation! Makeup goes on smoothly and does not 'pill' at all. It is a superior system, easy to use, packaged well, and it delivers excellent results. I love it!

I've been using the d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Pod for a little while now, and honestly, it's become one of those products I actually look forward to using. First of all, the pod packaging is super convenient. No guessing how much product to use, no messy bottles, and it's perfect for traveling. The serum itself feels super lightweight and silky on the skin. It absorbs surprisingly fast, which is a huge plus for me because I don't like waiting around for skincare to dry. My skin instantly feels hydrated, smooth, and refreshed without any sticky or greasy feeling. It gives that healthy, dewy glow that makes it look like you've been drinking way more water than you actually have. I've not tried a lot of liposome formula products, but this one makes it feel a little more luxurious, and my skin seems to stay hydrated longer throughout the day. It's one of those products that delivers noticeable results without feeling heavy or complicated.

I love this serum Mask pad, first of all feels very hydrating on my face I also apply the rest of the product to My neck and feel a big difference on the texture and also lols Very healthy and glowing.

The product is packaged well and included tweezers make it convent and less messy to use. If used as directed I had positive results starting after about a week. The mask does not leave any residue. Worth a try if you are looking for an easy use face mask set up.

avis.titre: Skin Was Smooth, Hydrated, and Makeup-Ready in Just 10-15 mi
avis.texte: I received this product free of charge in exchange for my honest opinion. Absolutely love the d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pad! The two-step routine is quick and easy to use. I started with the Green Peeling Pad, which gently exfoliated my skin and removed dry, rough patches without feeling harsh. Then I applied the Yellow Collagen Gel Pad, and within 5– 15 minutes my skin felt deeply hydrated, plump, and incredibly soft. My face looked brighter with a healthy glow, and my makeup applied so much more smoothly afterward. It created a flawless base that helped prevent my foundation from looking cakey or patchy. My skin felt refreshed, moisturized, and looked healthier all day. I have tried other products and not one has made my skin field and look this way. I will definitely be purchasing these again and highly recommend them to anyone looking for an easy way to achieve smooth, glowing, hydrated skin before applying makeup.

I have enjoyed using the d'Alba Double Quick Liposome Serum Mask Pad. My skin feels clean and refreshed after using the pads. I've noticed my skin has improved after using for a week and it's easy to use.

Beautiful luxurious packaging. There will be lots of extra serum left over that I can apply after the pads are gone. There's a cucumber fragrance to the exfoliating pad and a citrus fragrance to the collagen pad. Both were soft and un offensive and faded quickly. I am 53 and working to get glass skin. This is a beautiful set to add to my routine. It's appealing to use, very gentle, and I have experienced no breakouts. The acid is very light. I will be gifting this set to my girlfriend's for Christmas.

i have ready little bit about the product still haven't used it yet. Read that it gently exfoliate while giving your skin a nice boost of hydration. My skin feels soft, plump, and super glowy without any sticky feeling. They're perfect for a quick refresh or before makeup. A little pricey, but definitely worth it if you want an easy skincare step that actually works.

These are really more pads than mask, but you could layer it as a mask. One side is an exfoliation pad with dimpled pads. The other side is a serum that is cooling and hydrating. Both are very refreshing. Helps to smooth and plump skin.
